decisions.reason: Despite not being observed recently, the chart plugin builds on the established offer and likely remains part of integrated solutions.
The hierarchical search plugin was only briefly mentioned and lacks recent visibility, making discontinuation likely.
The mobile layer control solves a clear usability problem and was highlighted on the home page, so it probably remains core.
As the flagship platform central to the firm's direction, it is highly unlikely to be dropped.
Mobile field data capture remains relevant to GIS workflows, though it may be absorbed into broader mobile offerings.
Search extensions are easily replaced by built-in search and have not been promoted, so dropping is probable.
